   Wet weather expected for rest of November; temperature may dip to 23 deg C on a few days
 Sign up now: Get ST's newsletters delivered to your inbox
 More showers are expected in the second half of November.
 ST PHOTO: KELVIN CHNG
 Andy Ng
 Published   Nov 16, 2026, 05:18 PM
 Updated   Nov 16, 2026, 05:22 PM
 Set as preferred source Listen SINGAPORE – The rest of November is expected to continue to be wet, with thundery showers expected on most days, as well as temperature highs of 32 deg C to 34 deg C.
 It may even get slightly hotter than 34 deg C on a few days, and on some rainy days, there may be daily lows of around 23 deg C, said the weatherman on Nov 16.
 Rainfall during the second half of November is expected over parts of the island in the afternoon on most days, extending into the night on a few days, said the Meteorological Service Singapore in its fortnightly weather advisory.
 The total rainfall is forecast to be slightly above its long-term average.
 The Met Service also said that north-east monsoon conditions are expected to set in, with winds blowing mainly from the north-east or north-west and the monsoon season typically extends to March.
